text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Going by her last race, would you say
that
Nakayama Festa's got talent?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps, but just having talent isn't
going to cut
it. If she's really aiming for
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe as she
proclaimed, she should be able to win
this race without breaking a sweat.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I think it's still too early to judge. For
now, all we
can do is sit back and see
how she handles the
Classics.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha. The judging panel is brutally
honest as
usual.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But hey, the more I get pushed into a
corner, the
more excited I'm gonna get.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Did you manage to get any useful
information,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And did you figure out how you'll use
the info you
get from my performance
today?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're probably the only ones using the
Keisei Hai
as a way to gauge her chances
abroad.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll be watching you closely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spent over six months thoroughly
researching the Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe and compiling data
about
Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As of now, the Arc presents a steep
uphill battle
for the Umamusume of
Japan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Should I have Nakayama Festa rise to
meet the
challenge now, or wait until her
strength has
matured?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: I'll time things to bring out the ...
I'll find the right timing to brin...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Okay, here we go. The first crossroads
on the
road of destiny.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Nakayama Festa sets off
toward the
Keisei Hai paddock.
